instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: A secret society plotted a conspiracy against him.
atoms.b: A secret society plotted a ((conspiracy)) against him.

atoms.a: The prince surrounded himself with young, attractive aristocrats.
atoms.b: The prince surrounded himself with young, ((attractive)) aristocrats.

atoms.a: The scientist discovered a species of jellyfish with a unique characteristic.
atoms.b: The scientist discovered a species of jellyfish with a unique ((characteristic)).

atoms.a: Alexander’s greatest fear is to be a mediocre violinist.
atoms.b: Alexander’s greatest fear is to be a ((mediocre)) violinist.

atoms.a: I was looking for a peaceful, solitary place and found the local library.
atoms.b: I was looking for a peaceful, ((solitary)) place and found the local library.

atoms.a: You are unique, there is no one else like you.
atoms.b: You are ((unique)), there is no one else like you.
